name: Bulkbite App Shell
job: Orient signed-in BulkBite staff, expose the stock workflows, and keep the current task visible.

iconProvider.rule: Use familiar line icons beside persistent labels. Collapsed destinations retain accessible names and tooltips.

incomingHandoff: A signed-in staff member enters BulkBite operations and needs the current stock state or a specific stock task.
outgoingHandoff: The selected workflow receives the shared snapshot, stock data, and one clear operational focus.
responsiveBehaviour: Use a collapsible utility sidebar for setup and secondary records, plus one muted top area containing the page header and separated workflow tabs. On narrow screens recompose the sidebar into a compact full-width setup band while keeping account and authentication actions available.

layoutContract.containment: A collapsible soft-charcoal sidebar owns identity, high-contrast icon-labelled setup links, export, and one compact avatar-name-action account row. A unified muted BulkBite-orange top area owns high-contrast page identity, a fixed-footprint Refresh action, and separated workflow tabs without competing with the work canvas.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Workflow switching is immediate and state-driven; no movement is required to understand it.
